A '''Yuuzhan Vong''' was present on the [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]] ''[[Baanu Rass]]'' in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] encountered an enemy [[Myrkr strike team|strike team]] disguised as members of his species, and was inadvertently insulted by them.
